title: Among transactions at 'Discount' segment gas stations in the Czech Republic
question: Among transactions at 'Discount' segment gas stations in the Czech Republic, which year saw the largest difference in total consumption between EUR-paying and CZK-paying customers?

prediction.sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y', T1."XCL_011")
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1."XCL_013" = T2."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T3 ON T1."XCL_015" = T3."XCL_004"
WHERE T3."XCL_007" = 'Discount'
  AND T3."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
  AND T2."XCL_003" IN ('EUR', 'CZK')
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', T1."XCL_011")
ORDER BY ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_003" = 'EUR' THEN T1."XCL_018" ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2."XCL_003" = 'CZK' THEN T1."XCL_018" ELSE 0 END)) DESC
LIMIT 1;
